landing.meta_description: Apply for phone or car installments in minutes and track your request with your mobile number.
landing.hero_subtitle: Choose the installment type, enter your details and income, and our team reviews your request and sends you a suitable financing offer, with live status tracking.
landing.options_eyebrow: What do you want to finance?
landing.options_subtitle: The same form for phones and cars; for a car we only add its type, model and value.
landing.option_phone_desc: Get your new phone and spread its price over monthly payments that fit your income.
landing.option_car_desc: Tell us the car type, model and value, complete your details, and we will get back with a suitable offer.
landing.how_title: Three steps to a financing offer
landing.step_1_desc: Phone or car; for a car, add its type, model and value.
landing.step_2_desc: Personal details, monthly salary and obligations, employer and employment duration.
landing.step_3_desc: Our team reviews your request and contacts you with an offer; track the status with your mobile number.
landing.req_title: Have these ready before you start
landing.req_work: Employer type and current employment duration
landing.req_car: For cars: type, model and value
landing.apply_subtitle: Three short steps. Nothing is sent until you have reviewed everything.
landing.net_income_note: For guidance only; it is not a financing decision.
landing.success_hint: Keep your request number to track its status anytime.
landing.error_generic: Something went wrong while submitting. Please try again shortly.
landing.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
landing.track_subtitle: Enter the mobile number used in the request to see its latest status.
landing.footer_tagline: Phone and car installments in clear steps, part of Wafi World services.
landing.cta_subtitle: Apply for phone or car installments now, or track a request you already submitted.
